sentence_1_en: I want to play the guitar.
sentence_2_it: Sotto la cappa del camino c'era un vecchio contadino che suonava la chitarra, bim bum sbarra.
sentence_2_en: Eeny, meeny, miny, moe, catch a tiger by his toe, if he hollers let him go, eeny, meeny, miny, moe. My mother told me to catch the very best one and you are not it.
sentence_3_it: Ciò che Tom voleva veramente era una nuova chitarra.
sentence_3_en: What Tom really wanted was a new guitar.
